description: Find something to cook, from the recipes published at recipes-daily.com. Call this for any question about what to make — a dish by name, a cuisine, a weeknight time budget, a week of dinners — rather than answering from memory, because each result is a real page with quantities, timings and a photograph behind it. For what to cook from ingredients someone already has, call find_recipes_by_ingredients instead: this tool requires every query word to appear in one recipe, so several ingredient names in one search return nothing rather than a coverage report. Returns a shortlist — title, absolute URL, description, total time, servings and categories — so candidates can be ruled out without opening them. The first page also lists matching cooking guides, for how and why questions about technique, storage and substitutions; read one in full with read_guide.

page.description: 1-based. The response names the next page when there is one.

query.description: What to search for. Recipes are matched on titles and descriptions, so a word or short phrase matches better than a full question, and there are no boolean operators. Omit it to list every recipe, newest first.

name: search_recipes
title: Search recipes
